freeze_kind: Future third-party upstream PR requirements UNREAD before this public WhoSia seal; repository, eligibility rule, two actual architectures and hard abstention specified before discovery

actual_competing_architectures.architecture: radix/tree routing with path-priority; exposed map-oriented HeaderRouter in middleware
ordered route slice, regex-based matcher and registration chronology

same_declared_old_client: a GET handler registered for a noncolliding static /r11-p7/health path responds 200 and literal OLD; count exactly once and stable body; registration must be valid on BOTH original cores; any failure or missing clean setup is non-admission
cutoff_policy: architecture source snapshots predate selected upstream PR requirement. The histories and upstream tests must be kept separate from author-created adaptations and from actual project rights.

heldout_source_selection.sampling: Select the first TWO results by created_at ascending (tie-break by PR number). Do not inspect issue/PR body, patch or test source until this exact manifest is committed. If <2, select all; if 0, deterministic fallback query replaces route with path, same date and sorting. No cherry-picked replacements thereafter.
heldout_source_selection.eligibility: Real maintainer proposal accepted (merged) and later than pinned sources. If mismatch with routers, classify OOD rather than changing selection; infer request from PR body and actual changed original tests after lock.

predeclared_prediction_labels.DISJOINT_ROUTE: Both original cores expected to admit separate noncolliding route and preserve old health client with ONE registration. Nonunique minimal path patch ignored.
predeclared_prediction_labels.CHRONOLOGY_OVERLAP: For exact distinct overlapping path patterns, original Chi radial specificity vs Gorilla first-match chronological order expected to disagree on at least one submitted pattern or order. If actual holdout patterns differ materially ABSTAIN.
predeclared_prediction_labels.DUPLICATE_EXACT: A second registration same HTTP method and exact path may overwrite or error; exact behavior MUST be measured on both cores, direction NOT predicted and class treated ABSTAIN for sign.
predeclared_prediction_labels.ESCAPING_OR_DECODING: No comparative sign prediction. Need inspect actual handler-visible params, escaping and pattern grammar. Mark PREDECLARED_ABSTAIN rather than retrospectively favoring a framework.

source_cost_vector: For every valid source route, count initial registrations, modified original production files, add-on source files, operator actions, client migration, failed old contracts, original-run Go allocations+ns per comparable request; unknown review hours, institution rights, and historical effort report separately and as UNKNOWN, never impute zero.
